readout_other: VAS, LANSS, SF-MPQ, HAMA, HAMD; BOLD-fMRI ROI signal; EEG; EMG nerve conduction
direction_notes: Single patient with central post-stroke pain: pain, anxiety and depression scores fell after the 7 sessions and the abnormal BOLD ROI signal had normalised at day 150; no neural direction of effect was assessed.
safety_notes: No treatment-emergent adverse events reported, but EEG at the end of the last session showed epileptiform discharges during photic stimulation, absent at 2-month follow-up.

exposures.label: tLIFU to cingulum bundle ROI1 (left, healthy side)

timing.protocol_description: The therapeutic session lasted 20 min and was administered once daily for 7 consecutive days; focus aligned to the target by optical navigation and monitored in real time.

source_quotes.n_subjects: We present the case of a 66-year-old man who developed generalized cutaneous pain at rest 6 months after cerebral infarction, predominantly on the hemiplegic side (the left side).

flags.reason: Text gives ISPPA as 5.37 mW/cm2 and ISPTA as 53.73 mW/cm2; with a 1% duty cycle these look mutually inconsistent (the same paper cites 28.37 W/cm2 for a previous study). Recorded as stated, converted from mW/cm2; possible unit typo.
Stated as peak-to-peak acoustic pressure 0.83 MPa; domain not stated; recorded as 830 kPa without conversion to peak negative.
Only the 20 min session length is stated; whether it was one continuous train is not stated, and no pulse duration is given.
Target is an fMRI-defined ROI the authors say is consistent with the cingulum bundle, close to the left ACC.
